query:
UPDATE auth_tokens
           SET expires_at = NOW() + make_interval(days => $2),
               last_used_at = NOW(),
               device_name = COALESCE($3, device_name),
               client_kind = COALESCE($4, client_kind)
           WHERE token_hash = $1 AND revoked = FALSE AND expires_at > NOW()
           RETURNING expires_at
